summary: The P02 plan satisfies the bounded phase contract and has no unresolved material objection. It replaces hard-coded amounts with source-bound extraction, specifies exact reconciliation and adversarial checks, preserves unidentified histories, and separates note coverage from semantic completion. Current input and controller hashes support the packet’s baseline. This approves the plan only; the implementation, required tests and deliverables do not yet exist.
assumptions: P02 covers the retained fiscal 2024 annual and fiscal 2025 first-quarter Apple reports and their disclosed comparatives. It does not close the wider MC requirements or G1–G18.
The manifest and P01 register establish inventory and provenance; financial values and narrative assertions must be recovered from the bound source passages.

Nearest-rounding intervals remain an explicitly documented interpretation where issuer tie-breaking is unavailable. Displayed arithmetic and compatibility of underlying rounded amounts remain distinct checks.
Verification is deterministic extraction and reconciliation work. No stochastic ranking, forecast experiment or change to a default numerical policy is proposed.
checks: Confirmed that both retained original-file hashes match the Apple manifest and P01 records. P01’s coverage and source-evidence input hashes also match their current files.
Independently scanned the retained text and found 13 annual and 10 interim note headings. Checked that the final annual note ends before the auditor’s report and the final interim note before MD&A.

Inspected build_real_case.py and confirmed that its selected statement and debt values are authored constants. Inspected core_semantics.py and confirmed its explicit restriction to a frozen synthetic source. The proposed separate versioned module therefore addresses an actual implementation gap.

Inspected the annual debt table and the distinct cash-flow and balance-sheet cash labels. These support the planned sign, measurement and cash-perimeter rejection cases. Inspected interim Note 9 and confirmed that preserving its management assertion without inventing a probability or zero liability is necessary.

Checked the retained SEC submissions index for the annual, interim and 2025 proxy identities. P01 explicitly leaves the mirrored annual PDF’s publication date and historical byte vintage unresolved; the plan preserves that distinction.
Checked the current P02 catalog entry and refreshed next plan against the packet. All six supplied controller, catalog, schema, controller-test and master-plan hashes match.

Skeptical audit passed: source readings replace the wrong hard-coded baseline; note counts and arithmetic are not promoted into accounting or forecast validity; unsupported extraction, context, hashes and arithmetic veto acceptance; external-access failures block their dependent claims without stopping independent work; and no performance comparison creates an unfair-comparator issue.

The plan identifies its material assumptions, preserves frozen evidence, and proposes artifacts that answer the phase question. pdftotext and the existing BeautifulSoup installation are available. No implementation tests, acquisition commands or project writes were performed during this review.
residuals: The module, tests/test_accounting_p02.py, case.json and result.md remain unimplemented. Plan approval establishes no extraction correctness or successful reconciliation.

The P01 interim extraction and the existing Apple case interim text have different hashes despite sharing the same original HTML hash. Step 1 must retain separate extraction identities; character offsets must never be transferred between those text versions.

External proxy/agreement inspection, precise remaining incorporation obligations and publication-version evidence remain implementation work. The retained filing index alone does not establish historical availability or whole-document equivalence of the mirrored annual PDF.

Contract-level hedge allocation, reset schedules, asset cohorts and contingent outcomes remain unidentified where disclosures do not support them. Passing this phase would not establish complete accounting semantics, accounting compliance, full-company reconstruction, empirical forecast validity or human acceptance.
next_actions: Proceed with the implementation role under the reviewed plan, beginning with original-to-extraction bindings and source-derived arithmetic.

Implement the required real-input and adversarial tests, including extraction-specific offsets, context tampering, overlapping revenue partitions, cash perimeter and rounding boundaries; execute the specified unittest and build/check commands.
Complete the 23 note dispositions and specific incorporation/version records, then submit the actual code, generated case, result report and test evidence for review_result.
